name: Stuffed Egg Bento Box with Crackers, Apple, Almond Butter, Snap Peas & Cookies

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 4-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.
Wash and dry snap peas. Place snap peas and cookies each in the small compartments of the bento box.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup sugar snap peas
⅓ cup mini sandwich cookies

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; slice into wedges.
Place almond butter in a small container with a lid. Place apple slices and almond butter in the medium compartment of the bento box.
Halve eggs lengthwise, then scoop out the yolks and place in a small bowl. Add mayo, Dijon, salt, and pepper, then using a fork, mash to combine, creating a smooth paste.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp mayonnaise
¼ tsp Dijon mustard
1 pinch salt
1 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Spoon the yolk mixture back into the eggs. Place stuffed eggs and crackers in the large compartment of the bento box.
Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. Enjoy!
